assets.name: headphones
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent hero illustration for a music marketplace About page. Create a single large pair of premium over-ear studio headphones in a three-quarter view, diagonally tilted toward the lower left, the headband arching toward the upper right, large near earcup on the lower right. Thick soft black leather ear cushions, sculpted matte graphite body, metallic violet outer cup and headband rim with precise lavender highlights. On the near outer earcup, a small abstract glowing equalizer symbol made only of 6 short parallel diagonal bars, no letters or branding. Palette: deep graphite #171a20 and black, violet #9b5cf6, restrained pink-violet highlights #d946ef and pale lavender #d8b4fe. Premium dark clay and glass aesthetic, realistic materials and careful studio lighting. Entire object visible with small transparent margin. Headphones occupy almost all the square frame. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No floor, no stand, no cable, no text, no logo, no watermark, no UI. The glowing orbital ribbon around the headphones will be drawn separately in the page; generate headphones only. High-end detailed three-dimensional product rendering.

assets.name: vinyl
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent isolated three-dimensional illustration for the second section of a music marketplace About page. A floating exploded stack of exactly three dark violet glass square plates with generously rounded corners, shown in isometric perspective diagonally from upper left to lower right. Center layer is a large glossy black vinyl record with fine concentric grooves and a luminous purple circular center label and tiny center hole, resting on a square glass plate. Upper floating layer is a smaller rounded translucent dark purple square tilted upward, with one simple luminous lavender triangular play symbol in its center. Lower floating layer is another rounded dark glass square plate with a small equalizer made of thin violet bars near its front edge. Layers separated vertically with airy negative space, elegant thin neon violet edges, soft lavender reflections, realistic glass and vinyl materials. Palette: deep graphite #171a20 and black, violet #9b5cf6, restrained pink-violet highlights #d946ef and pale lavender #d8b4fe. Premium dark clay and glass aesthetic, realistic materials and careful studio lighting. Entire stack visible and centered within a square with transparent margins. Genuinely transparent background, no floor, no surrounding scenery, no text, no letters, no branding, no watermark. Premium detailed 3D product visualization matching a dark graphite music website.

assets.name: studio
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide transparent decorative studio illustration for the third/community section of a music marketplace About page. Composition: a centered anonymous music producer viewed entirely from behind, seated in a black studio chair, wearing a dark hoodie and large black studio headphones. No face visible. In front of the producer, a wide studio desk, a large central monitor displaying an abstract multitrack music session with fine purple and lavender horizontal audio tracks (no readable text), two large matching black nearfield studio monitor speakers with violet cones symmetrically placed left and right, small music keyboard on the desk. Wide landscape composition, isolated coherent studio workstation vignette; all speakers and monitor fit within the image. Camera behind the producer at head height, slightly elevated view of desk. Palette: deep graphite #171a20 and black, violet #9b5cf6, restrained pink-violet highlights #d946ef and pale lavender #d8b4fe. Premium dark clay and glass aesthetic, realistic materials and careful studio lighting. Photorealistic high-end 3D cinematic studio illustration, mostly dark with soft purple light emitted by monitor and subtle purple rim lights. Foreground silhouette dark and quiet. Genuinely transparent alpha background around the workstation and person, no rectangular room backdrop, no walls or floor, no extra people, no floating text, no logo or watermark. Wide 3:2 composition, important subject centered so it remains clear in a mobile layout.
